name: Hosaka Minori
source:
Leave it to Minori for all the live coverage of FC activities! A very wild broadcaster and club member.

[url=https://vndb.org/c22769]Mashiro's[/url] classmate. A boisterous and extremely lively girl. She is part of the broadcasting club and occassionally comes for live coverage of the FCC's activities.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
translation:
FC活动的直播报道就交给美纪吧！她是个非常狂野的播音员兼社团成员。

她是[url=https://vndb.org/c22769]真白[/url]的同班同学，性格喧闹、精力极其旺盛。她属于广播部，偶尔会为FCC活动进行现场报道。

[来源：[url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
